title: Forums
intro: Ask questions about writing, swap feedback and meet other writers. Anyone can read the forums. You need an account to post.
loadFailed: We couldn’t load the forums. Check your connection and try again.
neverClose: Threads with the latest activity come first. They never close on their own, so you can reply to an old thread any time.

rules.title: Forum rules in short
rules.first: Comment on the writing, not the writer.
rules.second: Don’t message people who asked you not to.
rules.third: Every post has a Report button. A person reads every report.
